mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID AS "groupId", TITLE AS "title", OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", STATUS AS "status", PURPOSE AS "purpose", REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", AMOUNT AS "amount", MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", MONTHS AS "months", PAY_DAY AS "payDay", ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", VISIBILITY AS "visibility", DESCRIPTION AS "description" FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE OWNER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY GROUP_ID DESC
